instruction:
Schema: users(id, name, email)
Create an index on the email column
output: CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email);

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, user_id, order_date)
Create a composite index on user_id and order_date
output: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_user_date ON orders(user_id, order_date);

instruction:
Schema: products(id, sku)
Create a unique index on sku
output: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_products_sku ON products(sku);

instruction: Drop the index idx_users_email from users table
output: DROP INDEX idx_users_email;

instruction:
Schema: logs(message)
Create a full-text search index on message column
output: CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX idx_logs_message ON logs(message);

instruction:
Schema: events(data)
Create a GIN index on JSONB data column in PostgreSQL
output: CREATE INDEX idx_events_data ON events USING GIN (data);

instruction:
Schema: locations(geom)
Create a spatial index using GiST
output: CREATE INDEX idx_locations_geom ON locations USING GIST (geom);

instruction:
Schema: employees(id, name, department_id)
Create a partial index for active department only
output: CREATE INDEX idx_emp_active_dept ON employees(department_id) WHERE status = 'active';

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, total)
Create an expression index on lowercased total cast
output: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_total_expr ON orders((CAST(total AS DECIMAL)));

instruction:
Schema: users(id, name, email)
Rebuild all indexes on users table
output: REINDEX TABLE users;

instruction: Get the execution plan for a query on employees
output: EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM employees WHERE salary > 50000;

instruction: Get the actual execution plan with timing for a query
output: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM employees WHERE department_id = 3;

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, user_id, total)
Optimize query to use covering index
output: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_covering ON orders(user_id) INCLUDE (total);

instruction:
Schema: sessions(user_id, token, expires_at)
Create index for fast token lookup
output: CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_token ON sessions(token);

instruction:
Schema: articles(title, body)
Create full-text index for searching title and body together
output: CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX idx_articles_search ON articles(title, body);

instruction:
Schema: transactions(id, account_id, created_at)
Create descending index on created_at
output: CREATE INDEX idx_tx_created_desc ON transactions(created_at DESC);

instruction: List all indexes on the employees table
output: SHOW INDEX FROM employees;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(product_id, warehouse_id, qty)
Create index to optimize GROUP BY queries
output: CREATE INDEX idx_inv_prod_wh ON inventory(product_id, warehouse_id);

instruction:
Schema: users(id, last_login)
Create index to speed up ORDER BY last_login queries
output: CREATE INDEX idx_users_last_login ON users(last_login);

instruction: Run VACUUM ANALYZE on the orders table in PostgreSQL
output: VACUUM ANALYZE orders;

instruction: Update statistics for all tables in MySQL
output: ANALYZE TABLE users, orders, products;

instruction:
Schema: audit_log(id, action, ts)
Create BRIN index for time-series data in PostgreSQL
output: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_brin ON audit_log USING BRIN (ts);

instruction:
Schema: customers(id, region, name)
Create hash index on region in PostgreSQL
output: CREATE INDEX idx_cust_region_hash ON customers USING HASH (region);

instruction: Disable index usage for a specific query to force sequential scan
output: SET enable_indexscan = off; SELECT * FROM employees; SET enable_indexscan = on;

instruction:
Schema: posts(id, author_id, published_at)
Create filtered index for published posts only
output: CREATE INDEX idx_posts_published ON posts(published_at) WHERE status = 'published';
